meta.name: muapi-giant-product-showcase
meta.description: Create a dramatic "Giant Product" visual where a regular item is showcased as a massive, building-sized object next to a person, then optionally animate the scene.

copy.tagline: 将普通物品放大为巨型建筑级视觉并可选动画
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要制作震撼的产品对比视觉来吸引眼球
copy.tagline_en: Create dramatic giant product visuals with optional animation
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to make eye-catching product comparison visuals

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能根据你上传的产品照片，生成一张该产品被放大到与人同高的展示图，并可选择进一步生成一段环绕产品的动态视频。
howto.when: 当你上传一张产品照片，并描述站在旁边的人物时触发。

say.text: 帮我生成一张巨型咖啡杯的展示图，旁边站一个穿西装的男人。
say.note: Claude 会生成产品与人对比的图片。

say.text: 把这张手表照片做成巨型产品展示，人物描述为一位时尚女性。
say.note: Claude 会使用你上传的图片生成展示图。

say.text: 给刚才的巨型产品图生成一段环绕动画视频。
say.note: Claude 会基于已生成的图片制作视频。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can generate an image of a product scaled to human size next to a person, and optionally create a cinematic video of the scene.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you upload a product photo and optionally describe the person next to it.

say_en.text: Generate a giant coffee cup showcase with a man in a suit next to it.
say_en.note: Claude will create the product comparison image.

say_en.text: Make this watch photo into a giant product display with a stylish woman.
say_en.note: Claude will use your uploaded image.

say_en.text: Animate the giant product image into a video.
say_en.note: Claude will generate a video from the previous image.
